jobs.description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------

Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.

**Job Overview**
----------------

We are seeking an exceptional, high-caliber **Senior Software Engineer / Developer** to join our **Commodities Technology** team based in **London**. Sitting at the intersection of quantitative and high-performance software engineering, this role is dedicated to delivering mission-critical market data infrastructure, services, and analytics feeds for our global Commodities trading desks.

As a senior individual contributor in a front-office environment, you will drive the architecture, design, and implementation of robust, low-latency market data pipelines and services across Commodities asset classes (Energy, Metals, Agriculture) with cross-asset touchpoints in FX, Rates, and Equities. You will partner directly with Front Office Traders, Model Quantitative Analysis (MQA / Quants), Market Risk, and Operations teams to build scalable solutions and integrate next-generation Generative AI and Agentic AI workflows into the development and trading lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

**1. System Engineering & Architecture**

* Architect, build, and optimize scalable, resilient, and high-throughput market data engines, curve builders, pricing integration layers, and real-time distribution services.
* Design and implement clean, modular APIs and event-driven architectures leveraging modern design patterns across **Java, Python, or .NET (C#)** ecosystems.
* Ensure ultra-reliable delivery of tick, end-of-day, and historical market data feeds to quantitative pricing libraries and trading applications.

**2. Front Office & Desk Alignment**

* Act as a direct technical partner to Front Office trading desks, understanding business drivers and rapidly translating complex trading/pricing requirements into production-ready software.
* Collaborate closely with **MQA (Quantitative Analysts)** to integrate pricing models, risk calculators, and real-time analytics.

**3. AI & Innovation Driver**

* Champion the adoption of **Generative AI** and **Agentic AI** frameworks within the software development lifecycle (e.g., automated code reviews, synthesis, workflow orchestration, agent-driven monitoring/troubleshooting).
* Prototype and evaluate agentic workflows for automated anomaly detection, market data quality validation, and intelligent developer tooling.

**4. Technical Leadership & Excellence**

* Drive engineering best practices: test-driven development (TDD), CI/CD pipelines, containerization, comprehensive observability, and low-latency performance tuning.
* Take end-to-end ownership of delivery—from requirement analysis and technical design to deployment, production monitoring, and support.
  

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**Technical Competencies**

* **Core Programming:** Advanced proficiency in at least one primary backend language:
  + **Java** (Modern Java, Spring Boot, concurrency, low-latency tuning, GC optimization), OR
  + **Python** (Modern Python, asynchronous programming, NumPy/Pandas, FastAPI), OR
  + **.NET / C#** (Modern .NET Core, multi-threading, asynchronous I/O, memory profiling).
* **Distributed Systems & Messaging:** Strong experience with enterprise messaging and streaming frameworks (e.g., Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, Solace, ZeroMQ, or gRPC).
* **Data Storage & Analytics:** Proficiency in relational databases (PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server) and time-series/caching technologies (e.g., Redis, InfluxDB, KDB+/q, or similar).
* **Modern DevOps & Cloud:** Practical experience with Git, CI/CD automation (e.g., GitHub , Tekton, Jenkins), Docker/Kubernetes/OpenShift, and Linux operating systems.
* **AI Tooling & Automation:** Demonstrated familiarity with LLMs, GenAI tools, and Agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, MCP tools, automated coding agents) applied to engineering productivity or domain solutions.

**Domain & Industry Experience**

* **Financial Services Experience:** Proven track record working within a Tier-1 investment bank, hedge fund, or major financial institution.
* **Asset Class Expertise:** Strong domain knowledge in **Commodities** (Power, Gas, Oil, Metals, Agriculture) or adjacent cross-asset products (**FX, Rates, Equities**).
* **Market Data Fundamentals:** Understanding of real-time market data structures, tick data, exchange connectivity, forward curves, volatilities, and reference data feeds.
  

  

**Mindset & Behavioral Attributes**

* **Self-Driven & High Ownership:** A true "go-getter" who takes proactive ownership of complex engineering problems with minimal supervision.
* **Stakeholder Management:** Exceptional communication skills with the ability to converse fluently with traders, MQA, risk managers, and technology leaders.
* **Problem-Solving & Agility:** Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-stakes Front Office environment where requirements evolve rapidly.
  

  

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree/University degree or equivalent experience
* Master’s degree preferred
  

  

**What we can offer you**

We work hard to have a positive financial and social impact on the communities we serve. In turn, we put our employees first and provide the best-in-class benefits they need to be well, live well and save well.

  
  

By joining Citi London, you will not only be part of a business casual workplace with a hybrid working model (up to 2 days working at home per week), but also receive a competitive base salary (which is annually reviewed), and enjoy a whole host of additional benefits such as:

* Generous holiday allowance starting at 27 days plus bank holidays; increasing with tenure

* Employee Assistance Program

* Special discounts for employees, family, and friends

Alongside these benefits Citi is committed to ensuring our workplace is where everyone feels comfortable coming to work as their whole self every day. We want the best talent around the world to be energized to join us, motivated to stay, and empowered to thrive.

jobs.title: Architect
jobs.description:
Due to an expanding portfolio of design led projects throughout Ireland and Northern Ireland, Hall Black Douglas are seeking an experienced architect with proven design skills, a rigorous approach to technical detailing and the complementary contractual skills to successfully deliver the design intent on site.

The position offers a variety of opportunities for career development within a collaborative and supportive environment, based in our Belfast studio, working on Cultural, Community, Health, and Education projects. Examples of ongoing cultural projects include Ulster Folk Museum Visitors' Hub and Galleries; Letterkenny Visual Arts Hub and Cathedral Quarter Park; Ulster Orchestra Performance and Rehearsal Space; Portlaw Community Hub and Urban Quarter, and Strand Cinema and Arts Centre.

Hall Black Douglas advocate a contextual approach to architectural and urban design, seeking positive transformation of the spaces and communities with which we work. This considered approach was recognised with the RSUA Liam McCormick Prize for Building of the Year 2026 for the Monaghan Peace Campus, alongside the inaugural Architects' Choice Award. The project also received both RSUA and RIAI Public Building and Accessible Design Awards.

Alongside new build projects, the practice has developed a reputation for both conservation and sensitive contemporary interventions within listed and heritage building settings and seek to take the same crafted approach to both new works and adaptive reuse, receiving RSUA/RIBA Regional Design Awards for Bank Buildings and St Comgall's Community Hub.

The practice has developed its own sustainability guidelines over 25 years and is currently delivering EnerPHit Passive House on listed buildings for Queen's University and have successfully delivered multiple NZEB and BREEAM Excellent projects, with Ballycastle Leisure Centre opening in 2027 as the first operational Net Zero Swimming Pool in Ireland.

Health Insurance, Cycle to Work scheme, RIBA Pension scheme, flexible hours, and Continual Professional Development are available to all staff. In addition to our regular in house CPD programme, targeted staff training is agreed at ongoing staff reviews e.g. NEC Project Management, Passive House, Conservation, PD/PSDP, etc. Team building activities have included tours of buildings under construction and those completed by the practice, a Taste of Belfast tour, Flout Pizza at Boundary, attendance at RSUA Awards and the recent RSUA Niall McLaughlin lecture.

**Essential Criteria:**

ARB or RIAI Registered Architect

Demonstrated architectural design skills

Demonstration of experience and technical ability at RIBA Stage 4 and 5

**Desirable Criteria:**

Proven competency in the design and delivery of high-quality architectural projects

Production of detailed Construction Drawing (BIM) and Specification (NBS) Packages

Contract Administration of Completed Projects at Construction Stage (UK/Ireland)

Experience of UK or Ireland Contracts

Demonstrated Communication Skills

UK/EU Driving Licence

Competitive salary. Negotiable given level of experience and expertise, with alternative working patterns considered.

We welcome applications from those experienced in the successful delivery new build projects or adaptive reuse/conservation.

jobs.title: Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Be part of a team assessing and driving achievement of program specific performance within Honeywell Global Product Engineering Services organization. Responsibilities will include MRB (Material Review Board) certification, Momentum Factory Support, DMAIC and Supplier support activities impacting the Honeywell Aerospace Yeovil Location and the sister divisions supporting that facility. In addition, you will work with Class II Design Authority for the Life support, engine bleed & environmental control, and hydraulic systems at Site for Phase 6 ECNs supporting ISC and will be leading the Engineering effort to release ECNs (Engineering Change Notifications). You will partner with world class engineer's supporting sites on day-to-day operations, product execution along the whole production pipeline and delivery to final customer, as well as drive improvements in engineering quality and productivity.

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
  
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

Control Systems develops the thermal and motion control systems that help aircraft take off, land safely and protect the people on board. With more than 10 million passengers per day flying on aircraft equipped with our products and more than 75% of commercial flights beginning with our engine start systems, Control Systems reaches farther across the aviation industry than most people realize.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Class II Delegated Design Authority for Phase 6 ECNs (Dwg changes in a production support environment); including Eng assessment, ECN generation, and coordination with Engineering teams for resolution to various Engineering actions driven by Factory support and supplier requests.
* Technical assessment execution and coordination with extended engineering teams for substantiation analysis such stress, alternate Material, dimensional variation, qualification and testing, engineering approval requirement execution etc. to ensure product integrity for both day-to-day operations support and supplier requesting Engineering actions.
* Technical customer interface for submitting approval packages for Dwg changes, this may require meetings, documentation preparation and coordination with various Customer support teams.

jobs.title: Head of Engineering (Associate Director) - Kings Cross Estate, London
jobs.description:
**Purpose of the Role**

The Head of Engineering Services will provide strategic leadership and operational oversight for all engineering functions across the Kings Cross Estate, ensuring the seamless delivery of building services, infrastructure & and sustainability initiatives. This role requires a visionary and strategic thinker, capable of aligning engineering operations with long-term estate objectives, enhancing asset value, and supporting a first-class experience for occupiers, residents, visitors, and stakeholders.

The HES will work hand in glove with the Operations Director, to whom they report on a day to day basis. There will be a dotted line to Director of Engineering Services within SMR with a view to ensuring the HES has access to a wider group of specialists and expertise within the wider Savills business to call upon as necessary to perform their role effectively.

The HES will provide clear strategic technical direction, strong, practical leadership, as well as operational planning. This is very much a solutions focussed role, underpinned by sound commercial acumen.

The HES will be directly responsible for managing the senior engineering manager, energy manager, and IT Digital, Innovation and Project Lead.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership**

* Develop and deliver a long-term engineering services strategy that supports the estate’s commercial, residential, retail, leisure, and public realm objectives.
* Act as a trusted advisor to the executive team on engineering, technical risks, energy management, and sustainability.
* Drive innovation in engineering solutions, integrating emerging technologies, smart building systems, and sustainable practices.
* Plan, forecast, and manage capital investment programmes and budgets to ensure the estate’s infrastructure is future-proof, resilient, and compliant.
* Lead the commercial management of key hard service contracts, have financial oversight (comprehensive agreements), and lead procurement and compliance at site level.

**Operational Management**

* Lead and oversee all building engineering services, including mechanical, electrical, public health, energy, and critical systems.
* Ensure engineering operations comply with statutory regulations, health & safety requirements, and industry best practice.
* Develop and manage performance standards, KPIs, and service-level agreements for in-house teams and third-party contractors.
* Oversee the maintenance strategy, ensuring a balance between reliability, cost efficiency, and sustainability.

**Team Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Lead a multi-disciplinary engineering team, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Build strong working relationships with occupiers, residents, retailers, local authorities, and service providers.
* Communicate complex engineering concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders, ensuring transparency and collaboration.

**Sustainability & Innovation**

* Champion the estate’s sustainability and net-zero ambitions, embedding energy efficiency and low-carbon technologies into operations.
* Identify opportunities for renewable energy, circular economy solutions, and intelligent building systems.
* Support the estate’s ESG commitments by integrating sustainable engineering into asset management and development plans.

**Health & Safety**

* Take and maintain responsibility for Health & Safety compliance for all technical systems and equipment.
* Ensure that every incident and accident is fully recorded, reported (including to insurers) and investigated and any remedial measures diligently attended to.
* Ensure the technical team achieve full compliance with statutory legislation (LOLER) and ensure that all records are fully maintained and available for inspection through DataStation
* Advise the Estate Director, Operations Director and Savills Technical Director immediately of any potential threats or reputational damage, major incidents or accidents resulting from an issue with the technical aspects of the estate. Report on any tenant related issue or any issue that could or will involve the HSE or EHO.

**Skills, Knowledge and Experience**

Key attributes:

* Strategic thinker with the ability to balance long-term vision with operational realities.
* Commercially astute, with strong financial and budget management skills.
* Collaborative leader who inspires trust, credibility, and engagement.
* Resilient, adaptable, and able to operate effectively in a fast-paced, multi-stakeholder environment.

Essential:

* Proven senior leadership experience in engineering or building services within a large, complex estate or portfolio (e.g., mixed-use, commercial, or critical infrastructure).
* Strong strategic and commercial mindset with the ability to align engineering services with estate-wide business goals.
* Ideally holds H&S qualification ISOH/NEBOSH.
* Fully conversant with Electrical installation and current IEE regulations/ British Standard BS 7671
* Operational knowledge of critical works and change management systems.
* Operational knowledge of HV/LV Networks and shutdown management
* Exceptional leadership, influencing, and communication skills, with experience managing large teams and external partners.
* Track record of delivering innovation, sustainability, and value creation through engineering services.

Desirable:

* Chartered Engineer status or equivalent professional qualification.
* Experience in smart building technologies and digital transformation in engineering services.
* Exposure to estates with high public footfall and complex stakeholder environments.

This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of duties, and you will be expected to perform different tasks as necessitated by your role within the organisation and the changes in the wider King’s Cross Estate development

jobs.title: Staff Engineer - Underwriting & Pricing
jobs.description:
**ABOUT HOMEPROTECT**

**Cover for Almost every Home**

We founded Homeprotect on a simple principle - to provide protection to people underserved by the home insurance industry. Since 2002, we've been combining smart technology with real human expertise to protect hundreds of thousands of unique homes across the UK, and we're just getting started.

If you're someone who loves solving interesting problems, taking ownership and working with a team that aims high, speaks up and lifts each other, Homeprotect is a place where you can do meaningful work, grow your career and make a real difference for our customers.

**What It's Like to Work Here**

Our customers come from all walks of life and so do our people. We're a small but perfectly formed team of insurance specialists, technologists, data scientists and customer champions - all bringing individual expertise, an appetite for innovation and a shared ambition to protect the homes and things people love.

We work at pace, but we trust our people to work in a way that brings out their best. You'll collaborate closely across teams, have real ownership from day one and see the impact you have first-hand with flexible working to help you balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life.

We've been recognised as a Great Place to Work UK for seven consecutive years - most recently ranked 29th nationally, jumping 71 places in a single year.

**ROLE PURPOSE**

Underwriting & Pricing decides which risks Homeprotect takes on and what we charge for them, one of the company's most strategically important and technically demanding domains, and one whose output, the price and terms of a quote, ripples through nearly every other part of the business: the journey that presents it to a customer, the policy created from it, and the numbers reported on afterwards.

We're looking for a Staff Engineer to shape the technical direction of this domain as its platform modernises, and to work across the boundary with the teams that depend on it, so pricing and underwriting changes can be made quickly, safely and with confidence across the business, not just within one team's codebase. At this level, you'll operate with a high degree of autonomy, defining technical direction rather than executing someone else's, and your influence will extend beyond a single team: you'll be the person other engineering teams turn to when a change touches pricing, quoting or underwriting logic.

Success in this role means Underwriting & Pricing's architecture and technical standards let the business change pricing and risk logic quickly and safely, and that other teams depending on the domain can build against it with confidence.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Technical Direction & Architecture**

* Define and own the technical direction and architecture for the Underwriting & Pricing domain: the pricing and rating engines, underwriting rules, risk appetite logic and quote calculation services.
* Make architectural decisions that affect multiple teams or systems, and document them clearly enough that others can act on them independently.
* Identify and drive the resolution of significant technical risk or complexity before it becomes a business problem, particularly around the accuracy and auditability of pricing and underwriting decisions.
* Lead the technical design of complex, cross-team initiatives from first principles through to delivery.

**Cross-Domain Technical Leadership**

* Act as the technical point of contact for other engineering teams whose systems depend on pricing, quoting or underwriting output.
* Influence architecture and engineering standards beyond the immediate team, helping the wider engineering organisation make sound decisions wherever they touch this domain.
* Represent Underwriting & Pricing in cross-team or organisation-wide technical discussions and decisions.

**Product & Business Partnership**

* Partner with the domain's Product Manager, Engineering Manager, and Actuarial and Commercial colleagues, to translate pricing and risk strategy into a technical direction that can support it.
* Help stakeholders understand technical trade-offs and constraints, and shape pragmatic solutions that balance commercial ambition with engineering rigour.

**Mentoring & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop senior engineers and emerging technical leaders within the team.
* Drive improvements to engineering practices, testing and operational rigour appropriate to a domain where correctness has a direct commercial consequence.
* Contribute to Homeprotect's wider engineering standards and architecture as the organisation's product engineering model matures.

**KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

**Essential**

* Proven experience as a Staff Engineer or equivalent, owning technical direction across multiple teams, platforms or a significant business capability.
* Strong track record of defining architecture and engineering standards independently, and communicating them clearly through documentation, design and discussion.
* Experience influencing engineering decisions across teams without relying on formal authority.
* Comfortable working with rules-heavy, calculation-intensive systems, where correctness, auditability and rigorous testing matter as much as delivery speed.
* Strong hands-on experience in at least one modern backend language, such as C# or Java (or a comparable object-oriented language).
* Deep, hands-on understanding of modern software engineering practices: continuous integration and deployment, automated testing, observability and cloud-native development.
* Experience operating production systems, in a public cloud environment such as Azure or GCP, that need to be reliable, secure, performant and auditable.
* Excellent communication skills, able to build trust and drive alignment with both engineers and non-technical stakeholders, including senior stakeholders.

**Desirable**

* Experience in general insurance, financial services or another regulated industry.
* Understanding of pricing, underwriting, actuarial or risk modelling concepts.
* Familiarity with Python, useful for working closely with Actuarial and data science colleagues on pricing and risk models.
* Experience building or evolving a platform or set of services consumed by multiple other engineering teams.
* Exposure to event-driven or distributed systems.
* Experience using AI-assisted engineering tools to improve engineering productivity.

**BENEFITS**

We want you to feel rewarded, supported and set up to thrive throughout your career with us.

**Learning and Growth:** We invest in your development through structured learning, mentoring, buddying, on-the-job experience and cross-functional projects. We support role-relevant professional qualifications where they'll make the biggest difference, and our Lunch and Learn sessions to help you stay connected to what’s going on right across the business.

**Health and Wellbeing:** Your wellbeing matters here. We offer private healthcare through BUPA, an Employee Assistance Programme covering legal, financial and counselling support for you, a Wellbeing Centre with online tools and resources, regular wellbeing seminars and workshops, annual flu jabs and an annual eye care voucher.

**Financial Security and Reward:** We offer an annual discretionary bonus scheme upto 30% of your base pay, life insurance at four times your salary, and a pension with Aegon. You'll also receive a significant discount on Homeprotect home insurance - with a friends and family discount too, and a staff referral bonus when someone you recommend joins the team.

**Time Off:** 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays, with the option to buy or sell up to five additional days each year.

**Genuine Flexible Working** We trust our people to work in a way that best suits them - with flexible working to balance the needs of your role with the rhythm of your life. We ask that everyone comes into the office at least once a week, as we believe in-person connection is important for collaboration, culture and building great relationships. You'll receive a homeworking starter kit from day one and can claim towards additional home office equipment within your first six months.

**Purpose and Community:** We care about more than just the work. Through our charity partnership with Refuge, the UK's largest specialist domestic abuse charity and regular social, wellbeing and charitable events throughout the year, there are plenty of ways to connect, give back and feel part of something bigger.

**UNIQUE AS STANDARD**

We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer and actively encourage applications from all backgrounds. We believe in celebrating difference - everything that makes both our customers and our people unique. We consider visa sponsorship on a case by case basis for the right candidate, so please don't let that stop you from applying.

We encourage you to let us know if you need any extra help with your application or have any requirements at any stage of the recruitment journey, we want the process to work for you.

*Your data will be maintained in line with our recruitment data privacy policy.*

***Regulatory Responsibilities***

*As an FCA regulated insurer, doing the right thing isn't a compliance requirement - it's simply how we work. All colleagues are expected to uphold the FCA Individual Conduct Rules (1–6) and act with integrity, due skill and care, openness with regulators and a genuine commitment to delivering good outcomes for our customers.*

*You'll work within approved processes and authority limits, keep accurate and auditable records, protect data under UK GDPR and our information security policies, escalate risks and exceptions promptly, report incidents, breaches and any financial crime or sanctions concerns (including via whistleblowing), support vulnerable customers with reasonable adjustments, and complete all mandatory training to maintain competence.*

*If the role falls within SM&CR, a supplementary document outlining the key regulatory responsibilities will be provided.*

**Change your career, change lives**
------------------------------------

The Open University is the UK’s largest university, a world leader in flexible part-time education combining a mission to widen access to higher education with research excellence, transforming lives through education. Find out more about us and our mission by watching this **short video** (you will be taken to YouTube by clicking this link).

**About Digital Services**
--------------------------

Digital Services is at the heart of delivering life-changing learning experiences that enrich society. We combine trusted design, data expertise, and cutting-edge technology to support lifelong learning.

Our objectives are to:

* Enhance the student and staff experience through simple, evidence-based solutions.
* Deliver value iteratively, securely, and at speed.
* Foster a vibrant, supportive workplace that embraces continuous learning and growth, empowering everyone to succeed.
  

As a service-led institution, we are committed to simplifying and improving how we work by organizing ourselves around the services we provide. This enables us to design and deliver outstanding services effectively and efficiently.

With our ethos of being “open to people, places, methods, and ideas,” we proudly support students in every setting imaginable—from submarines to prisons, and everywhere in between. We take pride in enabling our academics to teach and our students to learn, no matter the circumstances.

**About the Role**
------------------

We are recruiting multiple **Software Engineers** across a range of Digital Services teams. These roles sit within agile, product-focused environments delivering business‑critical digital services that support students, staff, and the wider University.

As a **Software Engineer** (known internally as an **Engineer**) at The Open University, you will contribute to the design, development, and support of high‑quality software solutions, working across the full software development lifecycle, from requirements analysis and system design through to coding, testing, and deployment.

These positions will work within product teams delivering and evolving user‑facing services, building scalable, secure, and user‑centred applications.

Engineers will work with modern engineering practices, contributing to CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, cloud-based delivery, and DevOps ways of working. You will gain experience working with a diverse technology stack, including cloud platforms such as Microsoft Azure and AWS, and will be supported in developing your technical capability and service ownership over time.

Engineers within Digital Services work across a modern technology landscape that includes.NET Core, ASP.NET MVC, REST APIs, React, Next.js, design systems and reusable component development, observability and OpenTelemetry, Microsoft Azure, Infrastructure as Code (IaC), and Headless CMS platforms. The technologies used will vary across teams and services, providing opportunities to apply existing expertise while working with a broad range of modern engineering practices.

In addition to building new functionality, you will support the services you develop, contributing to application monitoring, incident management, and ongoing improvements to reliability and performance.

Candidates are not expected to have experience across all technical areas. The specific technologies, team context, and areas of focus will be discussed during the recruitment process, alongside opportunities for learning and professional growth.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

* **Participate in Software Development:** Contribute to the development and enhancement of software systems throughout the software lifecycle, from design to deployment, following best practices and industry standards.
* **System & Software Design:** Assist in the design and documentation of software components and systems, working within established architectural patterns and standards, ensuring that solutions are scalable, reliable, and meet The Open University needs.
* **Program & Debug Software:** Write, test, and maintain high-quality code with accompanying test scripts and documentation, ensuring that it is well-structured, efficient, and aligns with project requirements.
* **Assist with System Integration:** Support the integration of various software components and systems, ensuring seamless interoperability and functionality.
* **Contribute to Testing Activities:** Contribute to test design and execution to validate software quality, ensuring functionality, performance, and security requirements are met.
* **Support Software Configuration Management:** Manage software configuration and version control, ensuring that changes are tracked, documented, and easily retrievable.
* **Data Modelling & Database Design:** Contribute to data modelling and assist with database design to support application development and data integrity.
* **User Experience & Analysis:** Support user experience design and analysis to ensure that the software solutions are user-friendly and meet stakeholder expectations.
* **Monitor Emerging Technologies:** Stay updated with emerging technologies and assess their potential impact on current and future projects.
* **Information Security & Quality Assurance:** Implement security measures and contribute to quality assurance processes to maintain the integrity and reliability of software systems.
* **Contribute to Services, Products & Requirements Analysis:** Engage in business analysis to understand stakeholder needs and help define and document technical requirements.
* **Evaluate Feasibility:** Conduct feasibility assessments for proposed solutions to determine their technical viability and alignment with project goals.
* **Non-functional Testing:** Perform non-functional testing to ensure systems meet performance, scalability, and security standards.
* **Support Application & System Operations:** Provide support for application and system operations, assisting in incident management, including on-call rotas and out-of-hours as required, and ensuring smooth functioning of services.
* **Availability & Capacity Planning:** Contribute to managing system availability and capacity, ensuring that services are reliable and scalable to meet current and future needs.
* **Problem Management:** Participate in problem management activities, including contributing to root‑cause analysis, post‑incident reviews, and follow‑up actions to improve system stability and resilience.

**About You**
-------------

**Key Skills and Experience:**

* **Software Development Lifecycle:** Solid understanding of the software development lifecycle, including design, development, testing, and deployment.
* **Software Design & Development:** Strong skills in designing and developing software solutions that are scalable and efficient.
* **Advanced Testing Knowledge:** Proficient in functional and non-functional testing to ensure the delivery of high-quality software products.
* **Data Modelling & User Experience:** Experience in data modelling and supporting user experience design to enhance software usability and effectiveness.
* **Emerging Technology Awareness:** Keen interest in exploring new technologies and their potential applications within the organisation.
* **Security & Quality Focus:** Understanding of information security and quality assurance practices to maintain the reliability and security of software solutions.
* **Analysis & Requirements Management:** Ability to analyse requirements and translate them into technical specifications.
* **System Support & Operations:** Basic experience in supporting application and system operations, troubleshooting issues, and ensuring system stability.
* **Modern Engineering Practices & AI Enablement:** Experience working in a modern engineering environment, applying practices such as automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, cloud-native development, and DevOps ways of working. Demonstrates effective use of AI-assisted development tools to enhance productivity, improve code quality, support testing and documentation, and enable faster delivery, while being mindful of governance, security, and cost considerations.
  

**Technology Stack:**

Our engineering teams work across a modern technology ecosystem including:

* **.NET Core and ASP.NET MVC**
* **REST APIs and integrations**
* **React and Next.js**
* **Design systems and reusable component development**
* **Observability, monitoring, and OpenTelemetry**
* **Microsoft Azure**
* **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**
* **Headless CMS platforms**
  

Candidates are not expected to have experience across all technologies listed but should be able to demonstrate strong engineering fundamentals and an eagerness to learn new tools and approaches.

  

**Behaviours:**

* **Problem Solver:** You approach challenges with a logical and analytical mindset, finding effective solutions to complex problems.
* **Collaborative:** You work well in team environments, sharing knowledge and ideas, and contributing to collective success.
* **Adaptable:** You thrive in a dynamic work environment and are open to learning new skills and technologies.
* **Detail-Oriented:** You have a keen eye for detail, ensuring that your work is accurate, high-quality, and aligns with project goals.
* **Curious & Innovative:** You stay updated on the latest industry trends and are always looking for ways to incorporate new ideas and technologies into your work.

**Support with your application**
---------------------------------

If you have any questions, or need support or adjustments relating to your application, the recruitment process, or the role, please contact us on 01908 541111 or email **careers@open.ac.uk** quoting the advert reference number.

**What's in it for you?**
-------------------------

At The Open University, we offer a range of benefits to recognise and reward great work, alongside policies and flexible working that contribute towards a great work life balance. Get all the details of what benefits we offer by visiting our **Staff Benefits page** (clicking this link will open a new window).

jobs.title: Power Platform Developer
jobs.description:
Do you have IT experience and have worked with modern data platforms? Then apply to join our team as a Power Platform Developer today!

Corporate staff

North Somerset

Post number: 1111

Hours: 37 per week

Contract: Permanent

Salary: Hay 7 (£37,563 - £40,444)

Closing date: Midday 19 October 2026

Police & Fire HQ, Portishead

Interviews: Week commencing 2 November 2026

  

**Summary of role**
-------------------

Responsible for designing, developing, and implementing custom Microsoft Power Platform solutions to enhance business processes and drive operational efficiency. As a Power Platform Developer, you will work closely with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and deliver efficient, user-friendly applications using the Microsoft Power Platform suite.

The role also includes participation in a compensated out-of-hours on-call rota for Priority 1 incidents, typically one week in every four, ensuring critical systems receive timely support when required.

**Some of the things you’ll be doing**
--------------------------------------

**Solution Design and Development (SFIA: Solution Development, Level 5)**

Analyse business requirements and design custom Power Apps solutions to meet organisational needs.

Develop and implement efficient and scalable Power Apps applications, ensuring adherence to best practices.

**Power Platform Expertise (SFIA: Solution Development, Level 5)**

Leverage advanced features of the Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Power Automate, CoPilot Studio, and Power BI to create comprehensive solutions.

Stay abreast of the latest Power Platform updates and continuously enhance skills to maximise the platform’s capabilities.

**Collaboration (SFIA: Collaboration and Operation, Level 4)**

Work closely with project managers and end-users to gather requirements and ensure successful implementation of Power Apps solutions.

Collaborate with the DDaT team to integrate Power Apps with existing systems and applications.

**Testing and Quality Assurance (SFIA: Testing, Level 4)**

Conduct thorough testing of Power Apps solutions to identify and address bugs, ensuring a high level of quality.

Implement testing methodologies and maintain documentation to support application reliability.

**User Training and Support (SFIA: Learning and Development, Level 3)**

Provide training sessions for end-users on how to effectively use PowerApps applications.

Offer ongoing support and troubleshooting to address user queries and issues.

**Security and Compliance (SFIA: Information Security, Level 4)**

Implement security measures to safeguard PowerApps solutions and ensure compliance with organisational policies and standards.

Stay informed about security best practices and apply them to protect sensitive data.

Carry out any additional responsibilities as reasonable and appropriate, as agreed with line manager.

**What we will need from you**
------------------------------

Essential

* Microsoft Certified: Power Platform Developer Associate — PL- 400

* Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a Power Platform role

* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Power Platform components, including Power Apps, Power Automate, CoPilot Studio and Power BI.

* Proven experience in designing, building, testing and supporting Microsoft Power Platform solutions, particularly Power Apps and Power Automate.

* Applying recognised design principles to implement components for Power Platform and cloud services (e.g. Azure), ensuring solutions are modular, secure and maintainable, and contributing to design discussions and refinements.

* Developing solutions using Power Platform and code-first approaches (e.g. C#, JavaScript), including extending functionality through custom plug-ins and PCF components, and contributing to peer reviews and improved development practices.

* Supporting integration of Power Platform services with external systems, and contributing to build and deployment activities using CI/CD pipelines and version control tools such as Git.

* Working with modern data platforms to implement secure data solutions, using technologies such as Dataverse, SQL Server, MySQL, NoSQL or PostgreSQL, and ensuring appropriate handling of sensitive data.

* Supporting users after go-live, including troubleshooting, minor enhancements and training.

* Ability to analyse business processes and identify opportunities for digital improvement.

* Ability to work with stakeholders at different levels of technical confidence

* Strong documentation discipline

* Ability to automate routine tasks and improve operational efficiency

* Ability to challenge poor practices and drive service improvement

* Willingness to accept and work to the NFCC Core Code of Ethics during the course of employment.

* Committed to undertake relevant training and continuous professional development opportunities.

Desirable

* Microsoft Power Platform, Microsoft 365, Azure, security or data certifications, such as PL-900, PL-200, PL-300, SC-900, SC-300 or AZ-900. Practical Microsoft Applied Skills credentials in Power Apps, Power Automate, Dataverse or Copilot Studio

* Professional ICT qualifications (such as ITIL or accredited status such as Chartered IT Professional CITP), or the equivalent gained through relevant training, experience and continuing professional development.
* Using Copilot Studio or alternate tools to enhance user experience or automate low-risk business activity.

* Knowledge of business process mapping techniques such as SIPOC, BPMN or value stream mapping.

* Knowledge of Agile delivery methods, including backlogs, user stories and iterative delivery

* Knowledge of one or more of the following coding skills would be beneficial to the role – PowerApps Formula Language (PowerFx), JavaScript, .NET (C#), SQL, RESTful APIs, HTML and CSS, PowerShell, GitHub or other Version Control Systems

**What you can expect in return**
---------------------------------

* 26 days annual holiday (plus public holidays) rising to 30 days after 5 years, and 31 days after 10 years of service
* Local Government Pension – Defined Benefit Scheme
* Electric Vehicle Salary Sacrifice Scheme
* Cycle to Work scheme
* Welfare and Wellbeing services
* Staff Networks
* Access to Westfield Health Supplementary Healthcare package.
* Access to Blue Light card with offers online and high street discounts
* Use of the multi-gym, sports hall, restaurant, free parking and beautiful open surroundings at our Headquarters in Portishead.

**How to apply**
----------------

  

If you experience any issues with the application or require a paper version please contact recruitment@avonfire.gov.uk . Late applications and any applications with no supporting statement will not be accepted. Please quote job reference number 1111 on any communications. Thank you.

*Avon Fire & Rescue Service is committed to securing equality of opportunity. We welcome applications from all members of our community who are currently under-represented at Avon Fire & Rescue Service, particularly women, Disabled people and members of ethnic minority communities.*

It is important for you to familiarise yourself with our work at Avon FRS and the framework we follow. Please see some resources below for you to read and explore:

Core Code Of Ethics – NFCC

Our mission, vision and values – Avon Fire and Rescue Service

jobs.title: Back-End Engineer (Senior)
jobs.description:
**Description**

  

### **About Xe**

Xe is a cross-border payments platform. We help SMEs and consumers in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, and New Zealand collect, convert, hold, and send money across markets. Each year, over 300 million people use Xe for currency information and over 350,000 use us to send money overseas.

Today, we're rebuilding the platform layer behind cross-border payments for corporate and consumer clients. We're small enough that your code ships fast and your decisions matter, and Euronet Worldwide (Nasdaq: EEFT) backs us so the problems stay real-scale.

### **About This Role**

We're hiring a senior back-end engineer who owns real problems end-to-end and shapes how the team builds, from API design and data modeling through to service implementation, production reliability, and launch. You already use AI as part of how you think, build, test, and ship.

You'll write code that moves money in production, design and modernize the backend services the platform runs on, and lead delivery of new capability as Xe rebuilds its platform layer. You'll work in a small team with direct access to product, compliance, and operations, own architecture in your domain, lead design reviews, mentor mid-level engineers, and partner with architects and team leads on cross-domain decisions.

### **What You'll Do**

* Design and own backend services that move money and manage multi-currency balances across a range of domains, including onboarding, KYC and KYB, payment initiation, FX, settlement, and other supporting services.
* Lead cross-functional delivery with product, compliance, and operations from problem framing through launch.
* Lead the build of the partner integrations and settlement infrastructure your domain depends on.
* Own production health for your domain, including reliability, observability, on-call, and incident response.
* Lead design reviews, set technical direction for your domain, and mentor mid-level engineers.
* Use agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) daily across the SDLC, and lead modernization from legacy services into the modern stack alongside architects and team leads in your domain.

### **What We're Looking For**

**Must-have**

* 6 to 10+ years building production backend services, end-to-end.
* Strong backend proficiency in C# / .NET preferred; other OOP languages welcome (Java, Kotlin, Go, or equivalent).
* SQL and relational database fundamentals.
* Writing and maintaining tests.
* Daily use of agentic coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude Code, or equivalent) across the SDLC.
* Production experience with AWS, including hands-on deployment, CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices, and native services such as SQS, DynamoDB, S3, ECS, and Lambda.
* Strong system design and architecture experience, including service-oriented or microservices and event-driven patterns.
* Payments, FX, or regulated-industry experience.
* Track record of technical leadership: mentoring engineers, leading design reviews, and making architecture decisions in your domain.
* Strong written and verbal communication.

**Nice-to-have**

* Experience with ledgers, double-entry accounting, or other financial-data systems.
* Experience hiring, interviewing, or onboarding engineers.
* Experience leading modernization or platform migrations.
* Experience with caching solutions like Memcached or Redis.
* Experience using project management and documentation tools like Jira and Confluence.
* Knowledge of API testing tools such as Postman or Bruno.
* Writing automated tests alongside development with AI tools (Claude Code or equivalent).

### **Perks & Benefits**

* Competitive Salary & Discretionary Bonus
* 23 days annual leave increasing with service (capped at 28 days)
* Paid day off for your Birthday
* 4% employer pension contribution
* Discounted Euronet ESPP
* Life Cover, Income Protection & Critical Illness cover
* Healthcare
* Plumm Mental Health and Wellbeing
* Volunteering day for a charity of your choice

We want Xe to be a great place to work and to ensure that our communities are represented across our workforce. A vital part of this is ensuring we are a truly inclusive organization that encourages diversity in all respects.

Xe is an **Equal Employment Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will be considered for employment regardless of age, national origin, race, color, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.** We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at recruitment@xe.com.

The position responsibilities outlined above are intended to define the general contents and requirements to perform this job. It is not to be taken as a complete statement of responsibilities or requirements. This job description does not restrict the Company's right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job as needed.

jobs.title: Senior Java Developer
jobs.description:
**Job Overview**

We are seeking a highly skilled and pragmatic Senior Java Developer to join our dynamic development team. In this role, you will lead the design, development, and implementation of robust software solutions that drive our business forward. Your expertise in Java and related technologies will be instrumental in creating scalable, high-performance applications. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver innovative features, optimize existing systems, and ensure the highest standards of quality and security. If you thrive in a fast-paced environment and are passionate about building impactful software, this opportunity is perfect for you!

**Responsibilities**

* Lead the full software development lifecycle for Java-based applications, including planning, coding, testing, and deployment
* Design and develop RESTful APIs to facilitate seamless integration with front-end systems and third-party services
* Collaborate with front-end developers using Angular, React, or other UI frameworks to create engaging user interfaces with HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and UI best practices
* Develop and maintain microservices architectures utilizing technologies such as Spring Boot, Hibernate, and WCF for efficient service communication
* Optimize database interactions through effective database design using MySQL, PostgreSQL, Microsoft SQL Server, or MongoDB
* Write clean, efficient code with a focus on unit testing and debugging to ensure high-quality deliverables
* Participate actively in Agile methodologies like Scrum to promote continuous improvement and timely project delivery

**Requirements**

* Proven experience as a Java Developer with a strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) principles
* Extensive knowledge of Java frameworks such as Spring (including Spring MVC),.NET technologies (.NET Core), and ASP.NET Core
* Hands-on experience with front-end development using Angular or React along with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, and Bootstrap for responsive UI design
* Familiarity with cloud platforms like AWS or Azure for deploying scalable applications
* Proficiency in working with RESTful APIs, SOAP web services, XML, JSON data formats, and API integration techniques
* Strong understanding of database management systems including MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server (T-SQL), Oracle PL/SQL or MongoDB for data modeling and database design
* Experience with version control tools such as Git or SVN to manage code repositories effectively
* Knowledge of SDLC (Software Development Life Cycle), UML diagrams for system modeling, and Agile methodologies like Scrum
* Ability to troubleshoot issues through debugging tools in Eclipse or Visual Studio and perform performance tuning where necessary
* Familiarity with Linux environments and scripting languages such as Bash or Shell Scripting for deployment automation

Join us to be part of an innovative team that values your expertise! We offer an environment where your skills will make a real impact on our products while supporting your professional growth through continuous learning opportunities. If you’re passionate about developing cutting-edge software solutions using Java and modern technologies—apply now to elevate your career!

Pay: £60,000.00-£80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Casual dress
* Free fitness classes

Ability to commute/relocate:

* London, Greater London: reliably commute or be willing to relocate with an employer-provided relocation package (preferred)

Education:

* Master's (required)

Experience:

* Project leadership: 3 years (preferred)

Licence/Certification:

* Driving Licence (required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**The role**

Technology drives what we do at NEXT, and as a Tech Placement, you will be a vital part of our evolution. This role is designed to help you learn and grow by giving you hands-on experience in full life-cycle development.

You will make a real difference by contributing to team objectives and helping to create and enhance new and existing systems. Working alongside and shadowing a supportive team of experienced Developers, Product Development Managers, Business Analysts, and Architects, you will receive the guidance you need to succeed.

**This is a 12-month industrial placement and applicants must be studying a relevant University Degree course that includes a dedicated placement year July 2027 to July 2028.**

**What you'll take on**

* Shadow our experienced Developers to learn about and participate in full life-cycle development.
  
* Help create and enhance applications using a wide variety of backend and front-end technologies, including C#, .NET, VUE.JS, HTML, and CSS.
  
* Write readable and maintainable code that fulfils user requirements to agreed quality standards.
  
* Collaborate closely within your team to troubleshoot, identify, and resolve bugs in the codebase.
  
* Implement, test, and deploy code changes following the company's development process.
  
* Participate actively in daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and code reviews to discuss challenges and share your progress.
  
* Adapt to and utilise new AI technologies, such as CoPilot, Gemini, and Notebook LM, to streamline your ways of working and increase efficiencies.
  

**What you'll bring**

* Current study towards a STEM degree (on track for a 2:1 or higher) or a STEM Master's degree that includes a 12-month placement, ideally with relevant studies in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a similar field.
  
* We are looking for someone with a strong interest in how software works and a self-motivated desire to learn.
  
* You will bring a basic understanding of core languages like C#, VB.NET, VUE.JS, HTML, CSS, and Javascript, alongside the ability to adapt quickly to new technologies.
  
* Beyond your technical potential, you will need to be a great communicator who listens well, thinks in a structured manner, and collaborates effortlessly with others.
  

BE BRAVE. BE YOU. BE NEXT.

  

* 25% off most NEXT, MADE\*, Lipsy\*, Gap\* and Victoria's Secret\* products (\*when purchased through NEXT)

jobs.title: Advanced Project Engineer
jobs.description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced, and motivated individual to join our site in Yeovil as an Project Engineer. You will be part of a team assessing and driving achievement of program specific performance within Honeywell Aerospace. You will be working on complex aerospace engineering projects across a variety of remits including Environmental Control Systems (ECS), Hydraulics, and Life Support Systems (LSS).

Join a company that's reintroducing itself to the aviation community we've helped advance for more than a century. At Honeywell Aerospace (NASDAQ: HONA), we're launching as an independent, publicly traded aerospace and defense company built on a legacy of operational excellence and mission-focused execution.

Our new brand identity pairs that heritage with real momentum, as we build technology that helps pilots navigate with confidence, aircraft operate more efficiently, and operators stay ahead of change. With our systems on board 90% of the world's aircraft, your work here has reach that's rare to find anywhere else.

Focusing on our customers, investing in innovation, and building a culture of accountability and performance is how we're shaping what comes next.
  
Every horizon. Every mission. Every day.

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. Explore our businesses: https://www.honeywellaerospace.com

Control Systems develops the thermal and motion control systems that help aircraft take off, land safely and protect the people on board. With more than 10 million passengers per day flying on aircraft equipped with our products and more than 75% of commercial flights beginning with our engine start systems, Control Systems reaches farther across the aviation industry than most people realize.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Create project plans, schedules, and determine milestones to customer expectations using earned value metrics
* Monitor and maintain project plans, ensure focus is maintained to milestone adherence to ensure products are delivered on time
* Create and monitor the progress of work packages for internal suppliers to support technical and schedule adherence.
* Build internal and external customer relationships throughout projects to ensure completion
* Ensuring that projects run within cost, quality, and time metrics
* Management of requirements, including requirements validation and the appropriate allocation of requirements
* Co-ordinate and Lead Design Reviews in accordance with HAY procedures
Manage project risks and mitigation plans.  

**Key requirements and skills**

* HND/HNC/Degree in mechanical engineering/aerospace
* Excellent communication skills, verbal and written
* Previous experience of working within a project engineering environment, and an understanding of the engineering lifecycle of a product from conception to commissioning
* Previous experience of using Microsoft Project, or a similar project forecasting system
* A strong understanding and experience of working with suppliers and integrated supply chains and how and where they fit in the project lifecycle

Millennium is a global, diversified alternative investment firm, founded in 1989. Defined by evolution, innovation and focus, Millennium’s mission is to deliver results for our investors.

Our people are empowered with both independence and support: the autonomy to pursue ideas with conviction and the backing of a global network committed to collaboration, disciplined risk management and continuous learning. jobs.description:
**Job Description**

**Why A365 Software Engineering?**  
  
Build the cloud platform that’s transforming electronics design. Altium 365 for cloud lets design engineers communicate, collaborate and bring their ideas to market more efficiently than any platform in the industry. These are some of the R&D Software Engineering contributions you might make to Altium 365:

* Building new cloud-native applications and scalable infrastructure
* Utilizing AI and ML to power advanced search capabilities
* Large-scale data processing; data modelling; holistic, intent-based API design
* Stateful and stateless servers, relational databases, ORM frameworks

Altium offers the opportunity to conceive and build new product features for electronics engineers, and add your own ideas to the world’s most collaborative and efficient electronics design platform.  
  
**A day in the Life of our** **Senior Software Engineer**  
Your primary role will be product development for complex cloud applications with the Altium 365 Platform team.

* .NET Core, .NET Framework 4.8., MySQL
* AWS cloud
* Microservices
* GitLab, Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes.

There are 100+ services in the product.

 **Qualifications**

* 7+ years of .NET experience
* Deep expertise in one or more of these areas:  
  identity and authentication, access or license management, message queues/brokers,  
  distributed caches, ElasticSearch/OpenSearch, relational database design and optimization,  
  platform framework development, multi-tenancy, Rings Protection Model in cloud development
* Proven experience building and operating distributed, high-load systems, including performance profiling, optimisation, load testing, and stress testing
* Strong ability to solve complex technical challenges that differ from typical market products, combining engineering software and cloud services
* Ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams and drive architectural decisions
* Experience defining and driving engineering standards, best practices, and technical governance at a platform level

**Nice to have**

* Firebird, Oracle, Postgres.
* Azure/GCP/AliCloud

  
**Additional Information**  

* Altium’s Website ( http://altium.com )
* Altium Customer Stories ( https://www.youtube.com/@AltiumStories )

Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.

We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

The ideal candidate combines solid CRM development experience with strong problem-solving skills and a passion for delivering reliable, scalable, and maintainable business applications.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, customize, and maintain solutions within Microsoft Dynamics CRM and Dynamics 365 environments.

* Design and develop plugins, custom workflow activities, and integrations using C# and .NET technologies.
* Support and enhance legacy Microsoft Dynamics CRM 2013 applications.
* Collaborate with business analysts, functional consultants, and end users to understand and implement business requirements.
* Integrate CRM systems with external applications using APIs, web services, and Power Platform technologies.
* Participate in code reviews, testing activities, troubleshooting, and defect resolution.
* Ensure application performance, security, stability, and maintainability.
* Contribute to technical documentation and support deployment activities.
* Provide ongoing support and continuous improvement for existing CRM solutions.

  

**What We Look For**

* Strong experience with **Microsoft Dynamics CRM 2013** and **Dynamics 365 (**Online and/or On-Premises).

**What We Offer**

* Private medical care, life insurance, and mental health & wellbeing support programs

* Multisport card and b-active program

jobs.title: Mjukvaruutvecklare / Embedded Software
jobs.description:

* Flera platser

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

Etteplan är ett internationellt teknikkonsultbolag med över 4000 specialister globalt. I Sverige arbetar vi nära våra kunder i tekniskt komplexa, ofta långsiktiga uppdrag där mjukvara är affärskritisk. Vi hjälper marknadsledande industriföretag inom exempelvis flyg, fordon, försvar och industriella system att utveckla robusta och framtidssäkra lösningar – i miljöer där kvalitet, tillförlitlighet och ingenjörsmässighet är avgörande. Hos oss är tekniken avancerad, men samarbetet är prestigelöst. Vi tror på tydlighet, förtroende och på kraften i erfarna team som tar ansvar tillsammans.

Vi samarbetar mellan våra kontor och anställer där kompetensen finns. Därför är du välkommen att söka även om du bor på en annan ort än den som anges i annonsen, förutsatt att du kan arbeta från något av våra kontor.

**Din roll**

Som **Mjukvaruutvecklare / Embedded Software** på Etteplan arbetar du i uppdrag där mjukvaran är en central del av helheten – ofta i system med höga krav på stabilitet, säkerhet och livslängd. Projekten kan omfatta allt från låg- och mellanlagernära utveckling till mer systemövergripande ansvar, beroende på din erfarenhet och kundens behov.

Du arbetar nära andra ingenjörsdiscipliner och har en viktig roll i att omsätta krav till hållbara tekniska lösningar. I många uppdrag förväntas du bidra med mer än bara kod – exempelvis genom tekniska resonemang, struktur, mentorskap eller ett helhetsperspektiv på systemet. För dig som vill finns också möjlighet att ta tekniskt ledande ansvar.

Vi rekryterar till flera av våra kontor runt om i Sverige och arbetar huvudsakligen regionalt, med hybridarbete där uppdraget tillåter.

**Din profil**

För att kunna möta våra kunders behov ser vi att du:

* Har ingenjörsutbildning inom datateknik, inbyggda system, elektronik eller motsvarande
* Har 3+ års relevant yrkeserfarenhet av mjukvaruutveckling, gärna inom embedded
* Har god erfarenhet av **C/C++, C#, Python** och arbete i **Linux‑miljö**
* Är van att arbeta enligt agila arbetssätt och etablerade utvecklingsprocesser
* Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska i tal och skrift

Det meriterande om du har erfarenhet eller kunskap inom AI, automatiserade byggen och testning, systemsäkerhet eller functional safety.

Många av våra uppdrag bedrivs i reglerade eller säkerhetsklassade miljöer, vilket ställer krav på struktur, dokumentation och professionell kommunikation. Därför söker vi dig som är trygg i din kompetens, arbetar metodiskt och tar ansvar för kvalitet i leveransen. Tjänsten kan innebära säkerhetsprövning enligt säkerhetsskyddslagstiftning, och för vissa uppdrag krävs svenskt medborgarskap.

**Att vara konsult hos Etteplan**

Som konsult hos Etteplan får du kombinera stabiliteten hos en etablerad arbetsgivare med variationen i olika uppdrag, tekniker och branscher. Du blir en del av ett erfaret ingenjörsnätverk där kunskapsdelning, långsiktighet och kvalitet står i fokus.

**Vi erbjuder**

Hos Etteplan erbjuder vi trygga anställningsvillkor med kollektivavtal, tjänstepension, försäkringar, vårdförsäkring och friskvårdsbidrag. Du får en flexibel arbetsmiljö med möjlighet till hybridarbete samt stöd från erfarna kollegor och närvarande konsultchefer. Vi värnar om balans i livet och skapar förutsättningar för både professionell och personlig utveckling.

**Ansökan och nästa steg**

Ansök genom att ladda upp ditt CV och besvara några korta urvalsfrågor. Processen inleds med en telefonavstämning och följs av samtal med konsultchef och vid behov tekniska kollegor.

**Vi har riktigt bra förmåner**
-------------------------------

* Cykelförmån
* Maxat friskvårdsbidrag
* Bil-leasing förmån
* Tipsbonus för tipsrekryteringar
* Personlig utveckling: utbildningsprogram & karriärmodell
* Kollektivavtal & lokala fackliga företrädare
* Föräldraledighet med upp till 90% av din lön
* Balans mellan arbete och privatliv, flexibla arbetstider och hybridarbete
* Bruttolöneavdrag för bl.a. 3D-skrivare, surfplattor, hörlurar, hemmakontorsutrustning mm.
* Privat vårdförsäkring

  

**Om företaget**
----------------

Etteplan är ett ledande ingenjörsföretag som formar framtidens industrier. Med en dynamisk och inkluderande arbetskultur, erbjuder vi spännande uppdrag, mångfaldiga kundrelationer och en miljö där din ambition får blomma. Vi är över 700 teknikspecialister i Sverige som brinner för teknik och människor. Tillsammans formar vi framtidens innovationer och utveckling inom en global affärsmiljö. Hos oss finns många möjligheter för dig som vill växa och utvecklas i en framåtsträvande organisation.

Forward focusWe take pride and ownership in our work as well as our personal and professional growth. For us, new technologies are opportunities waiting to be turned into our competitive advantage. With our foresight and proactive mindset, we advance the success of both our customers and Etteplan.

Bold thinkingWe explore new horizons, challenge ideas, and actively propose innovative solutions. We promote an environment of open dialogue, where we have the freedom to voice our opinions openly and honestly without fear of judgment.

Smarter togetherWe share ideas with one another, not just with our closest colleagues but across different disciplines and service areas. By learning together, we help foster a diverse community where knowledge flows freely, where collaboration knows no limits, and where everyone can feel they belong.

Jacob Mourad | Kontaktperson

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Vill du arbeta med avancerad mjukvaruarkitektur i en tekniskt ledande organisation? Hos oss får du en nyckelroll i att utveckla framtidens serviceverktyg och mjukvaruplattformar i nära samarbete med både interna team och internationella partners. Vi söker nu en Software Architect som vill kombinera teknisk spets med helhetsperspektiv.

**Som Software Architect kommer du att arbeta med:**

* Ta fram kravbilder och design av mjukvaruarkitekturer på system-, nod- och modulnivå
* Driva tekniska vägval, komponentval och bidra till roadmap för plattformar
* Stötta utvecklingsteam genom vägledning, utbildning och tekniskt ledarskap
* Delta i test, verifiering och releaseplanering av mjukvarulösningar
* Utföra avancerad felsökning samt ha dialog med intressenter

Som Software Architect inom vår mjukvarugrupp med fokus på serviceverktyg har du en central roll i att utveckla, vidareutveckla och säkra kvaliteten på våra mjukvarulösningar och plattformar. Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingskedjan, från att skriva/analysera krav och omsätta dem till hållbara arkitekturlösningar, till att säkerställa implementation, verifiering och vidareutveckling.

Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med utvecklare, designers och systemingenjörer, där du fungerar som en teknisk ledare och kunskapsbärare. Du bidrar till att skapa struktur och riktning i utvecklingsarbetet genom att definiera arkitekturprinciper, etablera standarder och driva kontinuerliga förbättringar.

Du har även en viktig roll i kontakten med andra delar av organisationen, såsom produktion, marknad, samt med övriga R&D. Genom denna samverkan säkerställer du att lösningarna möter både tekniska krav och verksamhetens behov.

Tjänsten passar dig som trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt, har en stark analytisk förmåga och vill ta ett stort ansvar i att forma framtidens mjukvarulösningar. Här får du möjlighet att påverka teknikval, driva innovation och bidra till att skapa effektiva och robusta system med höga krav på kvalitet, säkerhet och funktionalitet.

**Till tjänsten som Software Architect söker vi dig som har/är:**

* Civilingenjörsutbildning inom mjukvara eller motsvarande
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av fullstack med Windows-applikationer i C#, .NET och typescript/React
* God kunskap i engelska tal och skrift, meriterande om du även har goda svenskkunskaper

För att lyckas i rollen har du god kommunikativ förmåga, både skriftligt och verbalt och trivs med att samarbeta med andra för att nå gemensamma mål. Samtidigt arbetar du självständigt och har förmågan att driva aktiviteter framåt hela vägen till måluppfyllelse.

**Vilka är R&D Toyota Material Handling Europe?**
  
Toyota Material Handling Europe är världsledande inom materialhantering och vi gör stora investeringar för att möta framtidens behov. På vår R&D-avdelning i Mjölby arbetar 300 medarbetare med utveckling av våra produkter och tjänster samt nya innovativa lösningar. På Toyota arbetar vi med ett helhetsperspektiv där medarbetarna har ansvar från koncept till färdig produkt.
  
På Toyota förenar vi klassisk konstruktion med modern teknik inom automation, IoT och AI. Vårt produktutbud sträcker sig från manuella handtruckar till förarlösa fordon med avancerad teknik. På R&D avdelningen arbetar vi med korta utvecklingscykler för att möta efterfrågan på en snabbt växande marknad.

Medarbetarna inom R&D beskriver våra chefer och ledare som inkluderande, närvarande och prestigelösa. Vi på Toyota är måna om att skapa ett familjärt arbetsklimat med möjlighet till personlig utveckling och goda karriärmöjligheter.

**Din Framtid på Toyota Material Handling Europe**
  
På Toyota Material Handling Europe strävar vi efter att vara en vänskaplig, trygg och framåtsträvande arbetsplats. Vår kultur bygger på Toyotas värdegrund, där respekt och omsorg är centrala i det dagliga arbetet. Vi arbetar aktivt för att öka mångfalden och ta vara på olikheter, vilket stärker vår konkurrenskraft.
  
För att skapa förutsättningar till en hållbar vardag erbjuder vi våra medarbetare flextid och möjlighet till distansarbete på deltid.

Låter det intressant? Ansök i så fall senast 2026-10-25.

Du som söker jobb och har skyddad identitet ska kontakta HR, som kommer guida dig vidare för en säker ansökningsprocess.

**Kontakta gärna våra medarbetare för mer information:**

* Sandy Dahl, Rekryterande chef, sandy.dahl@toyota-industries.eu
* Josefin Nilsson, HR, josefin.nilsson@toyota-industries.eu

**AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals and minerals – safely, efficiently and more sustainably.**
