Condiciones:

Madrid – Hortaleza

Modelo híbrido

Jornada completa

¿Preparado/a para darle caña a .NET?

jobs.title: Software Engineering Team Leader
jobs.description:
**Descripción del empleo**

**¿Cómo marcarás la diferencia?**

Liderarás el desarrollo de nuestras aplicaciones de software para PC, junto con el equipo de desarrolladores y expertos, impulsando las mejores prácticas de ingeniería y coordinando al equipo para garantizar soluciones innovadoras, escalables y de alta calidad, alineadas con las necesidades de negocio y de nuestros clientes.

**¿Cómo será tu día a día?**

* Liderar el equipo de desarrolladores y expertos de software para PC.
* Definir la arquitectura y la evolución tecnológica de las aplicaciones.
* Planificar, coordinar y supervisar proyectos de desarrollo de software, asegurando el cumplimiento de plazos, calidad y objetivos.
* Establecer estándares de desarrollo, calidad de código, documentación y ciberseguridad.
* Gestionar prioridades, recursos y riesgos técnicos, apoyando al equipo en la resolución de problemas complejos.
* Colaborar con los equipos de Producto, Hardware, Firmware y otras áreas para desarrollar soluciones integradas.
* Impulsar la mejora continua mediante la automatización de pruebas, integración y despliegue continuo.
* Evaluar nuevas tecnologías y promover la innovación en productos y procesos de desarrollo.

**¿Qué queremos saber sobre ti?**

**Formación y base técnica**

* Grado en Ingeniería Informática, Telecomunicaciones, Electrónica o titulación equivalente.
* Se valorará formación de posgrado en ingeniería de software o gestión tecnológica.

**Experiencia profesional**

* Más de 5 años de experiencia en desarrollo de software.
* Al menos 2 años liderando equipos técnicos y proyectos de desarrollo.

**Conocimientos técnicos valorados**

* Desarrollo de aplicaciones de escritorio con tecnologías como C#, .NET, C++ o Python.
* Diseño de arquitecturas software y desarrollo de productos.
* Bases de datos SQL y NoSQL.
* Herramientas DevOps, control de versiones y entornos CI/CD.
* Metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban).
* Integración con sistemas embebidos, dispositivos electrónicos o entornos industriales.

**Competencias clave**

* Liderazgo técnico y gestión de personas.
* Orientación a resultados y visión de producto.
* Capacidad analítica y resolución de problemas.
* Comunicación efectiva y trabajo en entornos multidisciplinares.
* Innovación y aprendizaje continuo.

**Idiomas**

* Español: nativo
* Inglés: nivel alto (oral y escrito).

**¿Qué ofrecemos?**

* Flexibilidad horaria.
* Jornada intensiva los viernes y durante el verano.
* Medidas de conciliación para favorecer el equilibrio entre la vida personal y profesional.
* La oportunidad de liderar un equipo clave en el desarrollo de productos tecnológicos innovadores.

*Legal authorization to work in EU is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening.*

*Please note that we do not accept agency candidate submissions without a formalized agreement with Wabtec Talent Acquisition. If you are an agency/third party Recruiter and have not been engaged by Wabtec for this search, we do not owe you a fee if you submit a candidate to the applicant tracking system that is ultimately hired.*

*#LI-LF1*

 **Información adicional**

**¿Qué podrías lograr en un lugar donde las personas son lo primero?**

En Wabtec, no se trata únicamente de un empleo — se trata del impacto que generas.  
Cuando nuestra gente se une, ampliamos lo posible mejorando continuamente lo que hacemos y cómo lo hacemos — para nuestros clientes y entre nosotros.  
Si estás preparado para revolucionar la manera en que el mundo se mueve para las generaciones futuras, Wabtec es tu sitio.

**¿Quiénes somos?**

Wabtec es un proveedor global líder de equipos, sistemas, soluciones digitales y servicios de valor añadido para los sectores ferroviarios de mercancías y transporte público. Con más de 150 años de experiencia, lideramos en seguridad, eficiencia, fiabilidad, innovación y productividad. Ya sea en mercancías, transporte, puertos, logística, minería, industria o marina, nuestro conocimiento, tecnologías y personas están acelerando juntos el futuro del transporte. Con raíces que se remontan a George Westinghouse, Thomas Edison y Louis Faiveley, Wabtec siempre ha desarrollado tecnologías e implementado soluciones para sectores clave que satisfacen las necesidades tanto de clientes como de gobiernos.

Con aproximadamente 30.000 personas en nuestro equipo en todo el mundo, ofrecemos un rendimiento que impulsa el mundo hacia adelante. Somos aprendices de por vida, con una pasión constante por mejorar. Descubre más en www.WabtecCorp.com

La cultura nos impulsa y nos abre a nuevas posibilidades.

Creemos que las mejores ideas nacen de una combinación de experiencias y trayectorias diversas. En Wabtec, trabajamos cada día para crear un lugar donde todos se sientan parte y donde se valore la diversidad. Estamos construyendo una cultura donde el liderazgo, la inclusión y tu perspectiva única impulsan el progreso.

Creemos que las mejores ideas nacen de una combinación de experiencias y procedencias.  
En Wabtec, nos esforzamos cada día por crear un entorno donde todos se sientan incluidos. Estamos construyendo una cultura en la que el liderazgo, la inclusión y tu perspectiva única impulsan el progreso.

¿Necesitas algún ajuste o adaptación? Solo tienes que decírnoslo —estamos aquí para ayudarte.

jobs.title: AI Developer
jobs.description:
**Somos un equipo apasionado por la tecnología que vive la transformación digital con creatividad y excelencia.** Como partner líder de Microsoft en soluciones de **datos, inteligencia artificial, cloud, low code y productividad**, tenemos presencia en Valencia, Madrid, Tenerife y remote-first, y llevamos a cabo proyectos innovadores de alto impacto para clientes nacionales e internacionales. Nuestro propósito es **impulsar a las empresas a evolucionar** mediante soluciones vanguardistas, combinando la experiencia técnica con una visión fresca y audaz del negocio.  
  
**En ENCAMINA cultivamos una cultura diferente, donde cada idea cuenta y la colaboración es clave.** Creemos en el talento que *piensa en colores* y fomentamos el crecimiento continuo de nuestro equipo en un ambiente flexible, cercano y lleno de energía. Todos nuestros profesionales cuentan con la **IA como asistente diario**: utilizamos herramientas de inteligencia artificial para potenciar la creatividad, la productividad y el aprendizaje en cada proyecto. Si te apasiona innovar con las últimas tecnologías y quieres formar parte de un equipo que transforma retos en oportunidades, **¡te estamos esperando en el #ENCATEAM!**

Buscamos incorporar un/a **Desarrollador/a de Inteligencia Artificial (AI Developer)**. Una persona apasionada por la tecnología, el desarrollo de software y la Inteligencia Artificial, capaz de transformar necesidades de negocio en soluciones escalables, seguras y de alto impacto sobre Microsoft Azure.

Trabajarás junto a arquitectos, desarrolladores, consultores y clientes participando en la construcción de asistentes inteligentes, aplicaciones basadas en IA Generativa y soluciones avanzadas que ayuden a las organizaciones a aprovechar todo el potencial de la Inteligencia Artificial.

**Sabrás que esta posición es para ti…**

* Tienes experiencia profesional desarrollando software con tecnologías como **C#, Python o TypeScript**.
* Has trabajado construyendo soluciones cloud sobre **Microsoft Azure**.
* Conoces o has participado en proyectos de **Inteligencia Artificial Generativa**, utilizando tecnologías como Azure OpenAI, OpenAI o soluciones similares.
* Te gusta convertir requisitos funcionales y necesidades de negocio en soluciones técnicas viables.
* Estás familiarizado/a con conceptos como **RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation)**, embeddings, bases de datos vectoriales o sistemas de recuperación de información.
* Has trabajado con frameworks de orquestación como **Semantic Kernel, LangChain o similares**.
* Te preocupan aspectos como la escalabilidad, seguridad y mantenibilidad de las soluciones que desarrollas.
* Utilizas de forma habitual herramientas de Inteligencia Artificial para mejorar tu productividad y calidad de desarrollo.
* Disfrutas aprendiendo, compartiendo conocimiento y colaborando en equipos multidisciplinares.
* Puedes comunicarte con fluidez en inglés tanto de forma escrita como oral.

**Además, nos encatará conocerte si…**

* Has participado en el desarrollo de copilotos, agentes inteligentes o asistentes conversacionales.
* Tienes experiencia con **Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Azure Machine Learning o Azure OpenAI Service**.
* Has trabajado con soluciones basadas en contenedores utilizando **Docker, Kubernetes, Azure Container Apps o .NET Aspire**.
* Conoces herramientas de Infraestructura como Código como **Terraform, Bicep o Pulumi**.
* Tienes experiencia trabajando con GitHub Copilot u otros asistentes de desarrollo basados en IA.
* Dispones de certificaciones Microsoft relacionadas con Azure Development o Azure AI.
* Has participado en proyectos donde la IA genera impacto real en procesos de negocio.

**¿Qué harás en tu día a día?**

* Diseñar e implementar soluciones de Inteligencia Artificial sobre Microsoft Azure.
* Desarrollar e integrar servicios basados en Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Foundry y otros servicios cognitivos.
* Participar en la construcción de aplicaciones inteligentes, asistentes conversacionales y agentes de IA.
* Colaborar con arquitectos y equipos funcionales para transformar requisitos en soluciones técnicas.
* Aplicar buenas prácticas de ingeniería, calidad, seguridad y gobierno de la IA.
* Investigar nuevas capacidades, servicios y tendencias del ecosistema de Inteligencia Artificial.
* Compartir conocimiento y contribuir al crecimiento técnico del equipo.
* Participar en proyectos innovadores para organizaciones nacionales e internacionales.

**ENCAMINA te ofrece:**  
Contrato indefinido o colaboración como autónomo, nos adaptamos a lo que mejor te venga  
Impulsamos el desarrollo profesional y tu visibilidad en la comunidad técnica  
Confiamos en un modelo de trabajo Everywhere donde podamos trabajar desde donde nos gusta vivir  
Horario flexible  
Jornada intensiva los viernes de todo el año y tres meses en verano  
23 días de vacaciones al año y además podrás disfrutar del 24 y 31 de diciembre libres  
  
En ENCAMINA estamos muy comprometidos con ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades. Nos encantaría tener candidatas y candidatos con diversidad sin importar la raza, género, religión, nacionalidad, ciudadanía, discapacidad, edad, orientación sexual o cualquier otra característica protegida por la ley.  
  
Si ahora mismo no ves ninguna vacante que encaje contigo, ¡no pasa nada! Apúntate a nuestra posición **SUMA TU TALENTO**, que encontrarás en el apartado de empleo de ENCAMINA. Así podremos conocerte mejor y tenerte en el radar para cuando surja una oportunidad que encaje de verdad con tu experiencia y con lo que estás buscando profesionalmente

jobs.title: Databricks - Data Engineer (IC)
jobs.description:
We are seeking a talented and motivated Databricks Engineer to join our Analytics Technology team. In this role, you will design, develop, and optimize scalable data solutions that power business intelligence, advanced analytics, reporting, and AI-driven initiatives across the organization.

You will work closely with data engineers, analysts, architects, software developers, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality data products that enable data-driven decision making. The ideal candidate combines strong expertise in the Databricks Lakehouse Platform, modern cloud-based data architectures, and data engineering best practices. Experience with .NET/C# development is highly desirable and will support seamless integration between enterprise applications and modern data platforms.

This is an excellent opportunity for a data professional who enjoys solving complex business challenges, building scalable solutions, and contributing to the evolution of a modern analytics ecosystem.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable and efficient data pipelines using Databricks and cloud-native technologies.

jobs.title: Director of Engineering - MetaDefender Email Security
jobs.description:
OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage needed to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Over the last 20 years our commitment to innovative technology has earned the trust of more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions globally, solidifying our role in protecting the world's critical infrastructure and securing our way of life.

**Director of Engineering — MetaDefender Email Security**

**Reports to: VP, Products**

**Protecting the World's Critical Infrastructure**

OPSWAT, a global leader in IT, OT, and ICS critical infrastructure cybersecurity, delivers an end-to-end platform that gives public and private sector organizations and enterprises the critical advantage they need to protect their complex networks, secure their devices, and ensure compliance. Trusted by more than 1,700 organizations, governments, and institutions worldwide — including many of the world's largest governments, utilities, financial institutions, and defense contractors — OPSWAT protects the systems that keep society running.

**The Product: MetaDefender Email Security**

MetaDefender Email Security is OPSWAT's email threat prevention portfolio, trusted by governments and critical infrastructure operators to stop file-borne and email-borne threats before they reach the inbox. It comprises two complementary products designed for different environments and customer profiles — MetaDefender Email Gateway Security, deployed on-premises in front of existing mail servers, and MetaDefender Cloud Email Security, which augments Microsoft 365 — each embedding OPSWAT's threat prevention technology, including Deep CDR, Metascan Multiscanning, Proactive DLP, and Predictive Alin AI, directly into the mail flow.

This role owns the engineering for the products across both deployment models — the on-premises gateway and the cloud-native Microsoft 365 service — each with its own security, assurance, and operational demands, and all built to scale.

**About This Role**

We are looking for a Director of Engineering who leads from the front. This is a hands-on, technically-centric leadership role — not a pure people-management position — with full accountability for the engineering of the MetaDefender Email Security: architecture, delivery, quality, and the teams that build it. You will lead engineering across multiple deployment form factors — from air-gapped high security environments to native-cloud deployments — operating with the rigor of a principal engineer and the clarity of an executive.

You are an AI-native engineering leader. You have personally orchestrated fleets of AI agents to architect, build, test, and ship production systems, and you have launched and released real products through a full AI-powered software development lifecycle (SDLC) — from specification and code generation to automated testing, review, and deployment. Product Management defines what to ship; you define how to build it. You own the end-to-end delivery of the roadmap Product Management sets, hold the delivery bar, and build a high-performance culture the rest of OPSWAT's engineering portfolio will look to as a model for AI-native development. You report to the VP, Products and lead a distributed team across Romania and Hungary, while the role itself can be based anywhere — with a preference for the UK, USA, or near an OPSWAT-operated location.

**What You Will Be Doing**

* **Lead as an AI-first effort:** make AI agents a first-class part of how the team works — orchestrating agents to create specs, generate code and tests, verify results, and run reviews — while ensuring humans own and validate every line that ships. Treat automation and intelligence as the default, not the exception.
* **Stay hands-on:** remain directly in the codebase — setting architecture patterns, writing and reviewing critical code, prototyping, and unblocking hard technical problems. You lead by doing, not only by delegating.
* **Own end-to-end delivery of the roadmap:** take full ownership of delivering the product roadmap set by Product Management — turning the "what to ship" into the "how to build," and owning execution sequencing, technical risk, quality, security, and release across every deployment form factor.
* **Set technical direction (the "how"):** drive the architecture and technology choices that underpin a product serving high-assurance environments at scale. Hold a strong engineering point of view and be willing to defend it.
* **Build and lead a high-performance team:** recruit, develop, and retain top engineers and their leads across Romania and Hungary; create clear career paths and norms for code quality and review; and build a culture where strong engineers want to stay and grow.
* **Drive performance-based management:** set clear, measurable expectations and run a rigorous, fair performance culture — recognizing and accelerating top performers, raising the bar continuously, and addressing underperformance decisively by coaching where there is a path and upgrading or exiting the role where there is not.
* **Hold a security-first quality bar:** champion code review with a security lens for both human-written and AI-generated code, catching injection risks, insecure defaults, missing validation, and privilege-escalation vectors in file-handling and authentication paths before they ship.
* **Raise engineering velocity:** continuously improve how the team works — CI/CD pipelines, AI-assisted development workflows, incident response, and operational maturity — so the team ships faster and more reliably over time.
* **Codify AI-native practices for the portfolio:** establish the playbooks, AI context files, coding harnesses, test frameworks, and review norms developed on this product so other OPSWAT product teams can adopt them.
* **Partner cross-functionally:** work shoulder-to-shoulder with the VP, Products, plus Product Management, Design, and security leaders — turning the product roadmap (the what) into engineering execution (the how), committing to scope and timelines, and pushing back clearly when trade-offs require it.

**What We Need From You**

* **Full agentic development experience (required):** You have personally run a full agentic, AI-powered SDLC end-to-end — and have done so in B2B and high-security enterprise environments where compliance, data sensitivity, and assurance requirements are non-negotiable. You can show real work (PRs, commit history, shipped products, or a portfolio) where agentic workflows drove delivery — not slideware about AI.
* **A product launched via a full AI-powered SDLC:** demonstrable experience taking a product from spec to release using an end-to-end AI-assisted lifecycle (spec generation, code/test generation, automated verification, AI-assisted review, and CI/CD), with you accountable for the outcome.
* **Proven engineering leadership:** 8+ years of software engineering experience and 3+ years leading engineering teams (including managing managers/leads) through complex product delivery at scale. You can point to the decisions you made and why.
* **Performance-based leadership:** a track record of building high-performing teams through rigorous, fair performance management — promoting excellence, making timely talent decisions, and reducing or replacing low performers when needed.
* **Deep technical excellence:** strong, current software engineering fundamentals — solid command of design patterns, SOLID principles, and modern architecture. You can evaluate AI-assisted code with the same rigor as human-authored code. AI tools amplify strong fundamentals; they do not replace them.
* **Scalable systems experience:** a proven history building scalable, distributed solutions — including relational/document databases, cloud-native services, and modern CI/CD systems.
* **Quality and test discipline:** a high bar for tested, maintainable code; you use AI to accelerate test scaffolding, then validate that coverage is real and meaningful.
* **Distributed-team leadership:** demonstrated ability to lead and align engineers across countries and time zones, building trust, clarity, and accountability in a remote/hybrid, multi-country setup.
* **Talent magnet and clear communicator:** you identify strong engineers, make a compelling case for why they should join, and create an environment where they do their best work — and you communicate technical decisions to non-technical stakeholders without oversimplifying.
* **Security-conscious by default:** operating in critical infrastructure markets means security is never an afterthought; you hold the team to a security-first bar on design, code review, and incident response.

**It Would Be Nice If You Had**

* **Domain familiarity:** understanding of email as a communication channel and the underlying technology and protocols. Appreciation of the different deployment methods for email security and their characteristics.
* **Cloud services familiarity:** experience of integrating products with M365 and/or Google Workspace and their associated API ecosystems
* **.NET / C# ecosystem:** hands-on or managerial experience with .NET Core / C# — enough to evaluate architectural decisions, review PRs credibly, and hire well for the stack.
* **Cloud-native and containers:** experience leading the design or operation of cloud-native SaaS platforms — Docker, Kubernetes, and AWS/Azure/GCP — including using AI agents to script infrastructure and deployment automation.
* **AI context-file authoring:** experience writing AI context files (e.g., CLAUDE.md, .cursorrules, or equivalent) that encode architecture decisions and forbidden patterns for consistent, safe AI output across a team.
* **AI in CI/CD pipelines:** familiarity running AI agents inside pipelines — auto-fixing lint, generating missing tests, or running safe migrations as pipeline steps — not as experiments, but as how the team actually works.
* **International team experience:** a track record of building and maintaining engineering culture and delivery quality across multiple countries and time zones.
* **Async and high-throughput systems:** experience validating concurrency and thread-safety in high-throughput services.

**Why You'll Love Working Here**

* Lead a product trusted by critical infrastructure customers across air-gapped, cross-domain, internet-connected, and native-cloud deployments — the architecture and culture decisions you make now will shape it for years.
* Influence beyond this product: the AI-native patterns you establish will propagate across OPSWAT's engineering portfolio.
* Work from anywhere — a worldwide, remote-friendly role with a preference for the UK, USA, or a location near an OPSWAT-operated country.
* Stable, growing international company with an exceptional customer base across 50+ countries.
* A mandate to build AI-native engineering practices — and the latitude to do it your way.
* Attractive compensation with regular performance assessments and flexibility for the right candidate.

new_jobs.title: Software Engineering Intern – Device Simulation & Digital Twin
new_jobs.description:
**Company Description**

At **KEENFINITY Group**, we are a globally leading provider of innovative and professional security and communication solutions. With over 4,000 employees in over 50 countries worldwide, our ambition is clear: we offer more than just technology – we secure, connect, and amplify the moments that matter in life.

Our Audio business is part of the Keenfinity Group and operates as an independent company – giving our iconic brands the independence and agility to thrive in today’s market. As part of a global family that includes **Bosch, RTS, Electro-Voice, Dynacord, and Telex**, we deliver world-class professional audio, building safety, intercom, and communication solutions that connect concerts, broadcasts, houses of worship, stadiums, and schools. We develop and manufacture these systems in our own plants across Europe, the Americas, and Asia.

Our vision is to be the industry’s most admired company, driven by customer success. We strive to live and work according to our core values of Customer Success, Passion, Boldness, and Integrity.

Customer Success: Unmatched customer experience, end to end.

Passion: We love what we do, it drives everything we deliver.

Boldness: We challenge the status quo. We innovate. We lead.

Integrity: We do the right thing. Always.

**What’s in it for you?**  
Working with us means experiencing the best of both worlds: the global impact and prestige of industry-leading brands, combined with the agility and entrepreneurial energy of a newly independent company. In this dynamic environment, your ideas will not get lost in bureaucracy. We empower you to take true ownership, accelerate your growth, and collaborate with passionate experts worldwide to build solutions you can genuinely be proud of.

 **Job Description**

As a **Software Engineering Intern – Device Simulation & Digital Twin**, you will help us rebuild and significantly expand the software simulator for our **DICENTIS conference devices**. The simulator acts like real hardware on the network, allowing our development and test teams to validate server behavior, run automated regression tests, and develop software without always needing access to physical devices.

We already have an existing simulator, but it currently covers only a limited set of device behaviors and runs on an aging technology stack. Your project will be to rebuild it using a newer technology foundation that we are already investing in, while expanding its coverage from approximately **30% to 80–90% of real device behavior**.

You will work on a long-term project with a tangible impact on how our engineering teams develop, test, and maintain our products. The final solution will run on **both Windows and Linux** and become an important part of our automated testing and development environment.

During your internship, you will:

* Get familiar with the existing device simulator, DICENTIS devices, and the newer technology stack used for the rebuild.
* Analyze the behavior and capabilities of real devices and identify which scenarios are already simulated and which are still missing.
* Define and prioritize the device behaviors required to significantly expand simulator coverage.
* Design and implement new simulated device scenarios using **C# and/or C++**.
* Develop software that communicates over the network and behaves like the corresponding physical devices.
* Make the simulator compatible with both **Windows and Linux**.
* Develop and maintain automated tests that use the simulator as a replacement for physical hardware.
* Integrate the simulator into our automated build and test pipeline, including continuous integration where applicable.
* Document supported device behaviors, architecture, usage, and known limitations.
* Work closely with engineers and testers to understand their needs and ensure the simulator is practical for everyday development and testing.
* Break down a long-term project into manageable milestones and provide regular progress updates to your supervising team.

  
**Qualifications**  

* You are currently pursuing a **Bachelor's or Master's degree** in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical/Electronic Engineering, or a related technical field.
* Solid programming skills in **C# and/or C++**.
* Good understanding of **object-oriented programming and software design principles**.
* Basic understanding of networking concepts such as **TCP/IP, client-server communication, and networked devices**.
* Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and break down a larger project into manageable steps.
* Good written and spoken **English** communication skills.
* Motivation to learn, investigate technical problems, and develop a solution from an existing foundation.

It is a plus if you have:

* Experience with **.NET or .NET Core**.
* Familiarity with network protocols or device communication standards.
* Experience with **automated testing** or continuous integration tools such as Jenkins.
* Experience working in a **Linux-based development environment**.
* Coursework or project experience in software engineering, networking, embedded systems, or distributed systems.
* An interest in **audio, conferencing technology, embedded systems, or connected devices**.

  
**Additional Information**

**What We Offer:**

* A hands-on internship in an international team.
* Close guidance from experienced professionals.
* A dynamic role where your input and ideas are appreciated.
* The option to work from home one day per week.
* An internship allowance between €500 and €600 per month (based on full-time employment).

**Application process:**

* Interested? Hit the apply button!
* Phone meeting with a Keenfinity Group campus recruiter;
* Interview with team members;
* Contract offers from Keenfinity Group.

**Join us at KEENFINITY!**

At Keenfinity Group we don’t just build innovative solutions — we shape a smarter, more connected world through technology.

We value different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences and we’re committed to growing, learning, and celebrating success as one team. Everyone is welcome here — we foster an environment where everyone is respected, valued, and encouraged to be their authentic self.

Keenfinity is an equal opportunity employer, offering equal opportunities for all. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and can offer support, if needed. When everyone has a chance to contribute, we all do better.

new_jobs.title: ICT Engineer (Starter / Medior)
new_jobs.description:
**ICT Engineer (Starter / Medior) – Microsoft 365, Cloud, Netwerk & Security**

Wil jij niet jarenlang alleen wachtwoorden resetten en printers installeren, maar juist ontdekken hoe complete ICT-omgevingen echt werken?

Bij **Bewust ICT in Asten** krijg je die kans.

Wij zoeken een **ICT Engineer** die zich breed wil ontwikkelen binnen Microsoft 365, cloud, networking en cybersecurity. Of je nu net van school komt, al een paar jaar ervaring hebt of vanuit een andere ICT-functie de volgende stap wilt maken: als jij techniek interessant vindt en graag wilt blijven leren, willen we je spreken.

Bij ons word je niet in één klein hokje geplaatst. Je werkt mee aan de complete ICT-omgeving van onze klanten en krijgt steeds meer verantwoordelijkheid naarmate je groeit.

**Locatie:** Asten  
**Dienstverband:** Fulltime  
**Werkvorm:** Op kantoor en incidenteel bij klanten  
**Niveau:** Starter / Medior  
**Salaris:** Tot € 3.750 bruto per maand, afhankelijk van kennis en ervaring

Dit is Bewust ICT

Bewust ICT is een full service ICT-partner voor MKB-organisaties.

Voor onze klanten zijn wij verantwoordelijk voor vrijwel de volledige ICT-omgeving. Van laptops, Microsoft 365 en telefonie tot servers, cloudomgevingen, netwerken, firewalls, monitoring en cybersecurity.

We zijn een klein en hecht team met korte lijnen. Geen grote organisatie waarin je jarenlang maar één onderdeel beheert, maar direct samenwerken met engineers die complete klantomgevingen ontwerpen, implementeren en beheren.

Daardoor kom je bij ons in korte tijd met veel verschillende technieken en situaties in aanraking.

En misschien nog belangrijker: **als jij wilt leren, krijg je bij ons ook daadwerkelijk de kans om dat te doen.**

Wat ga je doen?

Geen dag is precies hetzelfde.

De ene ochtend help je een gebruiker met een Microsoft 365-probleem. Even later onderzoek je waarom een Conditional Access-policy een aanmelding blokkeert. Daarna help je mee met een nieuwe Intune-uitrol, troubleshoot je een VPN-verbinding of configureer je samen met een collega een netwerk bij een klant.

Je werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

* ICT-meldingen aannemen, analyseren en daadwerkelijk oplossen
* gebruikers ondersteunen via telefoon, e-mail, remote support en incidenteel op locatie
* Microsoft 365, Exchange Online en Entra ID beheren
* Windows 11-werkplekken installeren, beheren en beveiligen
* werken met Microsoft Intune, Autopilot en endpoint security
* Windows Server-omgevingen beheren en troubleshooten
* ondersteunen bij Azure en Azure Virtual Desktop-omgevingen
* switches, access points, VLAN's, VPN-verbindingen en firewalls beheren
* werken met onder andere Fortinet en TP-Link Omada
* monitoring, patching en proactief beheer van klantomgevingen uitvoeren
* securitymeldingen en kwetsbaarheden onderzoeken en opvolgen
* meewerken aan cybersecuritymaatregelen bij klanten
* terugkerende werkzaamheden automatiseren met bijvoorbeeld PowerShell
* meedenken over hoe we klantomgevingen en onze eigen dienstverlening slimmer, veiliger en efficiënter kunnen maken

Je hoeft dit natuurlijk niet allemaal op je eerste werkdag te kunnen.

Dat is juist het leuke van deze functie: **je begint op het niveau waar je nu staat en wij helpen je om steeds verder te komen.**

Geen klassieke helpdeskfunctie

Natuurlijk hoort support bij je werk. Maar we zoeken niet iemand die de hele dag alleen tickets doorschuift.

Bij Bewust ICT willen we dat je leert onderzoeken:

Waarom werkt iets niet?  
Waar zit het probleem?  
Hoe kunnen we het structureel oplossen?  
En kunnen we voorkomen dat hetzelfde probleem opnieuw ontstaat?

Zie je iets wat beter kan? Dan horen we dat graag.

Naarmate je kennis groeit, krijg je steeds meer vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid. Van zelfstandig klantvragen oplossen tot het uitvoeren van wijzigingen en uiteindelijk het ontwerpen en implementeren van complete oplossingen.

Met welke technieken werken we?

Onze klantomgevingen zijn breed. Je kunt onder andere werken met:

**Microsoft & Cloud**  
Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Exchange Online, Intune, Autopilot, Microsoft Defender, Azure en Azure Virtual Desktop.

**Servers & Werkplekken**  
Windows 11, Windows Server, Active Directory, Hyper-V, storage en virtualisatie.

**Networking & Security**  
Fortinet, firewalls, VPN, VLAN's, routing, switching, wifi en TP-Link Omada.

**Beheer & Automatisering**  
NinjaOne, monitoring, patching, PowerShell en API's.

Je hoeft echt niet overal ervaring mee te hebben. We noemen deze technieken vooral om te laten zien hoeveel verschillende kanten je bij ons op kunt.

Wie zoeken we?

Diploma's en certificaten zijn mooi, maar voor ons zeggen motivatie, technische nieuwsgierigheid en de manier waarop je problemen aanpakt minstens zoveel.

We zoeken iemand die:

* bij voorkeur een afgeronde MBO- of HBO-opleiding richting ICT heeft
* starter is of al enige ervaring heeft binnen ICT-beheer of support
* een goede basiskennis heeft van Windows en Microsoft 365
* Nederlands goed beheerst, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk
* het prima vindt om klanten telefonisch te helpen
* graag uitzoekt waarom iets niet werkt
* verantwoordelijkheid neemt voor een probleem en niet alleen een ticket doorschuift
* logisch en gestructureerd kan troubleshooten
* nieuwe technieken graag zelf onderzoekt
* zorgvuldig werkt, zeker wanneer het om security gaat
* zelfstandig kan werken, maar ook een collega inschakelt wanneer dat slimmer is
* klantvriendelijk en duidelijk kan communiceren

En misschien wel het belangrijkste:

**Je hoeft niet alles te weten, maar je moet het wel willen weten.**

Kun je bij een technisch probleem zeggen: *“Geen idee waarom dit gebeurt, maar ik ga het uitzoeken”*?

Dan pas je waarschijnlijk goed bij ons.

Een **rijbewijs B** is voor deze functie erg handig, omdat we ook bij klanten op locatie werken.

Hier kun je naartoe groeien

Wij zoeken niet iemand die de komende jaren precies hetzelfde blijft doen.

Waar jij uiteindelijk naartoe groeit, hangt voor een groot deel af van waar je goed in bent en waar je enthousiast van wordt.

Je kunt je bijvoorbeeld verder ontwikkelen richting:

**Cloud & Microsoft 365**  
Intune, Azure, Entra ID, Microsoft 365, automation en moderne werkplekken.

**Networking**  
Fortinet, switching, wifi, VPN, routing en complete netwerkomgevingen.

**Cybersecurity**  
Microsoft Defender, identity security, Conditional Access, hardening, monitoring en security operations.

**Systems & Infrastructure**  
Windows Server, Hyper-V, Azure, storage, backup en virtualisatie.

Of misschien blijkt juist dat jij het leuk vindt om van alles wat te doen. Ook dat past uitstekend bij een full service ICT-bedrijf zoals Bewust ICT.

Wij investeren in jouw ontwikkeling

Als jij gemotiveerd bent om beter te worden in je vak, helpen wij je daarbij.

Je krijgt bij ons:

* begeleiding van ervaren engineers
* veel praktijkervaring in verschillende klantomgevingen
* tijd en mogelijkheden om nieuwe technieken te leren
* trainingen, cursussen en opleidingen
* mogelijkheden om relevante certificeringen te behalen
* steeds meer zelfstandigheid en verantwoordelijkheid
* ruimte om je te specialiseren in de richting die bij jou past

Je zult daardoor waarschijnlijk regelmatig met technieken werken waarvan je een jaar eerder nog nooit had gehoord.

Dat vinden wij juist mooi.

Ook je salaris kan meegroeien met je ontwikkeling. We spreken samen leerdoelen af. Het behalen van relevante certificeringen, afgesproken leerdoelen en meer zelfstandigheid zijn voor ons concrete momenten om samen naar een volgende salarisstap te kijken.

Wat bieden wij jou?

* een bruto maandsalaris tot **€ 3.750**, afhankelijk van je kennis en kunde
* salarisgroei op basis van je ontwikkeling, leerdoelen en behaalde certificeringen
* een laptop voor je werkzaamheden
* € 0,25 reiskostenvergoeding per kilometer wanneer je meer dan 10 km van ons kantoor woont
* een afwisselende functie binnen een groeiend ICT-bedrijf
* veel vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid
* werken met moderne ICT-, cloud- en securitytechnieken
* een combinatie van support, beheer en projecten
* direct contact met klanten en ervaren engineers
* mogelijkheden voor trainingen en certificeringen
* doorgroeimogelijkheden binnen verschillende technische richtingen
* een informele werkomgeving met korte lijnen
* Brabantse gezelligheid en een team waarin we elkaar helpen

Goed om vooraf te weten

Wij vinden samenwerken op kantoor belangrijk.

Je werkt in deze functie **fulltime vanuit ons kantoor aan Het Hoogvelt 14 in Asten**, behalve wanneer je bij een klant bent.

Fulltime remote werken is geen onderdeel van deze functie.

Omdat je iedere werkdag in Asten bent, sluit de functie vooral goed aan als je uit de regio komt of als dagelijks naar Asten reizen voor jou een logische en praktische keuze is.

Waarom Bewust ICT?

Omdat je hier niet wordt aangenomen voor een klein stukje ICT.

Je krijgt juist de kans om te ontdekken waar je goed in bent.

Je leert hoe een Microsoft 365-omgeving wordt beveiligd, hoe een firewall werkt, waarom een VPN niet opkomt, hoe je een netwerk segmenteert, hoe Intune een apparaat beheert, hoe je een serverprobleem onderzoekt en hoe je ervoor zorgt dat complete klantomgevingen veilig en up-to-date blijven.

En dat allemaal terwijl je onderdeel bent van het team dat verantwoordelijk is voor de ICT van echte organisaties.

Wil jij over een paar jaar terugkijken en denken:

**“Bizar hoeveel ik hier heb geleerd.”**

Dan moeten we kennismaken.

Interesse?

Stuur je CV en een korte motivatie naar:

**werkenbij@bewustict.nl**

Een motivatie hoeft van ons geen formele brief van twee pagina's te zijn. Vertel ons vooral wie je bent, waar je nu staat en waarom ICT je interessant vindt.

Heb je nog niet overal ervaring mee, maar spreekt de functie je wel aan?

**Reageer dan vooral.**

We zoeken liever iemand met de juiste instelling die nog veel wil leren dan iemand die toevallig ieder vinkje uit een vacaturetekst kan afstrepen.

Salaris: €2.500,00 - €3.750,00 per maand

Arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Budget voor professionele ontwikkeling
* Kerstpakket
* Kosteloos parkeren
* Reiskostenvergoeding
* Vrijdagmiddagborrel

Taal:

* Nederlands (Vereist)

Werklocatie: Fysiek

new_jobs.title: Computer Vision Engineer
new_jobs.description:
### **Description**

As a Computer Vision Engineer, you'll join a collaborative team developing SLAM, perception and sensor-fusion capabilities for real-world navigation and mapping products. The role sits at the intersection of computer vision, navigation, geospatial data and embedded systems.

With the support from experienced colleagues, you'll contribute to products and technologies used across automotive testing, autonomous systems, surveying and mobile mapping applications.

If you've worked on projects that combine LIDAR, Cameras, GPS, accelerometers or gyroscopes on a moving platform, we'd love to hear from you!

  

### **Key Responsibilities**

We’re looking for someone who can:

* Apply software engineering, mathematical and analytical skills to solve interesting technical problems and support the continued development of OXTS products.
* Help us developing software that combines LIDAR, cameras, Global Navigation Satellite Systems (GNSS), inertial sensors and advanced mathematical techniques to deliver highly accurate positioning, orientation, motion and mapping data.
* Contribute to technical investigations, algorithm evaluation, experimental analysis and innovation activities that support future product development and technical roadmaps.
* Take responsibility for technical deliverables, have autonomy over your day-to-day engineering work, and keep growing your expertise while collaborating with colleagues on shared team and project goals.

### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise**

Essentials

* Degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, related Degree or equivalent experience.
* A genuine interest in continued learning and professional development
* Experience in at least one of: computer vision, SLAM, robotics, mapping, perception and/or sensor-fusion systems.
* Experience delivering production-quality engineering software.
* Understanding of software architecture, code quality, testing and CI/CD.

Nice to have

* Experience with LiDAR and camera data processing.
* Experience with IMU/GNSS-aided sensor fusion.
* Experience with C++, C# or Python in engineering software.
* Familiarity with Linux, Docker, CUDA or GPU acceleration.
* Understanding of navigation, localisation or mapping products.
* Familiarity with React or web-based visualisation tools.
* Experience using AI coding assistants to improve engineering productivity.

  

### **Benefits**

  

* Discretionary annual profit share bonus
* 27 days annual leave plus bank holidays
* 5% employee and 5% employer contributions through our via our salary sacrifice workplace pension scheme
* Group Income Protection Insurance Scheme
* Private Medical Insurance
* Death In Service Scheme
* Electric Vehicle Scheme
* Smart casual dress code

  

### **About OXTS**

At OXTS we’re passionate about inertial navigation and how we can help our customers with our technology. With two decades of experience in combining the best of high precision GNSS receivers and world-class inertial navigation expertise, OXTS’ products have become the industry standard for automotive testing and are widely used in other industries.  
  
The highly accurate RT3000 products are the equipment of choice for vehicle dynamics testing. Our products are used by major car manufacturers and automotive test facilities around the world for applications such as handling and dynamics evaluation, brake testing, steering robot guidance and many more. With the RT-Range S products, OXTS also offers a complete solution for validating advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS) to Euro and global NCAP standards and for developing the self-driving cars of the future.  
  
Away from the automotive world, our range of combined, compact GNSS/INS systems are also used for airborne and vehicle-based survey and mobile mapping applications, where continuous position and high accuracy orientation information is essential for georeferencing sensor data.  
  
OXTS’ GNSS/INS products are supplied with a comprehensive software suite including powerful data analysis and post-processing applications. We also provide a full technical support service, plus a bespoke technology integration consultancy via our Application Engineering department. Our products are sold and supported globally through a network of channel partners in more than 20 countries worldwide, to provide customers with a local point of contact and support.
